# vitepress-plugin-llms

> 📜 A VitePress plugin for generating LLM-friendly documentation

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/okineadev/vitepress-plugin-llms): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://npmx.dev/vitepress-plugin-llms): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
